acceptanceCriteria: External evidence import rejects unknown or mismatched provider/subject/digest/validity; valid receipts are bound to repository and Work Item
and required policy evidence can reference only valid delegated receipts.
goal: A strict delegated evidence receipt is source-bound, digest-bound, validity-aware, Work Item-bound, and visible to governance decisions.
intent: Import, validate, bind, display, and archive externally produced evidence without manufacturing provider assurance.
